violation_type.title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))
violation_type.short_title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months
violation_type.typical_finding: Infant room teacher was observed to not have pre-service training available  for review within caregiver record. The hire date was observed as 10/7/25.

finding_variants.text: Infant room teacher was observed to not have pre-service training available  for review within caregiver record. The hire date was observed as 10/7/25.
One caregiver has 0 of the required 24 hours of pre-service trainings.

It was determined that a caregiver supervising infants was found to not have the proper training to care for children under 24 months when hired.         This was corrected when the director removed the caregiver and placed a caregiver qualified to care for children under 24 months in the infant room.
A caregiver, hired in July of 2023, is missing shaken baby/SIDS/brain development pre-service training. The caregiver was observed supervising children in a pre-toddler class during inspection.
The operation has one caregiver missing the required 8 hours of pre-service training and one caregiver missing the required 24 hours of pre-service training.

The Preservice training taken did not include the infant trainings for shaken baby syndrome,  SIDS, and safe sleep.This was corrected at inspection when the certificate was received, printed, and placed in the file.
